name: Bahasa Inggris
description: Materi lengkap SKL PSAJ Bahasa Inggris SMPIT Ummul Quro Kelas IX - Kurikulum Merdeka Tahun Pelajaran 2025/2026. mencakup Menyimak-Berbicara, Membaca-Memirsa, dan Menulis-Mempresentasikan.

topics.title: Listening & Speaking
topics.description: Ungkapan kepastian, ketidakpastian, memberi pendapat, serta kesukaan dan ketidaksukaan.

content.text: Certainty adalah ungkapan kepastian, sedangkan Uncertainty adalah ungkapan ketidakpastian. Keduanya digunakan saat berdiskusi atau memberikan pendapat tentang sesuatu.

A: Are you sure the test is tomorrow?
B: Yes, I'm certain that the test is tomorrow.
A: Really? I doubt that. I heard it's next Monday.
B: Maybe you're right. I'm not sure anymore.
Gunakan 'I'm certain' untuk kepastian tinggi dan 'I doubt' / 'I'm not sure' untuk ketidakpastian.
Ungkapan untuk meminta dan memberi pendapat dalam diskusi formal maupun informal.

items: Do you have any idea about...?

content.text: Gunakan 'I think' untuk pendapat umum dan 'I strongly believe' untuk pendapat yang lebih kuat.
Ungkapan kesukaan dan ketidaksukaan terhadap sesuatu.

items: He is not fond of spicy food.

flashcards.question: Ungkapan certainty yang kuat?
flashcards.answer: I'm certain that... / There's no doubt that...

flashcards.question: Ungkapan uncertainty?
flashcards.answer: I'm not sure... / I doubt that... / Maybe...

flashcards.question: Cara memberi pendapat formal?
flashcards.answer: In my opinion... / From my point of view...

questions.question: Which sentence shows UNCERTAINTY?
options: I doubt that he will come.
questions.explanation: 'I doubt that' menunjukkan ketidakpastian.

questions.question: Choose the correct expression to ask for opinion:
options: What do you think about this?
questions.explanation: 'What do you think about this?' adalah cara meminta pendapat.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I _______ listening to music.
questions.explanation: Setelah like gunakan V-ing, dan subjek I menggunakan like (bukan likes).

topics.title: Procedure Text
topics.description: Teks prosedur: fungsi sosial, struktur, fitur kebahasaan, dan mencari informasi spesifik.

content.text: Procedure text adalah teks yang berisi langkah-langkah atau cara melakukan sesuatu. Tujuan utamanya adalah memberikan instruksi atau panduan.

items: Materials / Ingredients: Bahan-bahan yang dibutuhkan (jika ada)
Steps / Methods: Langkah-langkah yang harus dilakukan
Menggunakan imperative sentence (kalimat perintah): Cut, Mix, Put, Add
Menggunakan action verbs: turn, stir, pour, boil
Menggunakan sequence connectors: first, then, next, after that, finally
Menggunakan adverbs of manner: slowly, carefully, gently

content.text:
How to Make a Cup of Tea

Materials:
- 1 tea bag
- 1 cup of hot water
- Sugar (optional)

Steps:
1. First, boil the water until it is hot.
2. Then, put the tea bag into the cup.
3. Next, pour the hot water into the cup.
4. After that, wait for 3 minutes.
5. Finally, add sugar if you like and stir well.
content.translation: Contoh teks prosedur cara membuat teh.

content.text: Perhatikan penggunaan kata sambung urutan: First, Then, Next, After that, Finally.

flashcards.question: Contoh sequence connectors?
flashcards.answer: First, then, next, after that, finally.

flashcards.question: Jenis kalimat utama dalam teks prosedur?

questions.question: What is the social function of a procedure text?
questions.explanation: Teks prosedur berfungsi untuk memberikan instruksi/langkah-langkah.

questions.question: Which of these is a sequence connector?
questions.explanation: 'First' adalah sequence connector yang menunjukkan urutan.

questions.question: 'Cut the paper into small pieces.' This is an example of:
questions.explanation: Kalimat perintah (imperative) adalah ciri khas teks prosedur.

topics.title: Report Text
topics.description: Teks report: fungsi sosial, struktur, fitur kebahasaan, dan menemukan informasi spesifik.

content.text: Report text adalah teks yang mendeskripsikan sesuatu secara umum, seperti hewan, tumbuhan, fenomena alam, atau benda. Tujuannya untuk memberikan informasi faktual.

items: General Classification: Pengenalan umum tentang topik
Description: Deskripsi bagian-bagian, ciri-ciri, sifat, atau perilaku
Menggunakan noun phrases: a large mammal, sharp teeth
Menggunakan linking verbs: is, are, has, have

content.text:
The Elephant

The elephant is the largest land animal. It has a long trunk and large ears. Elephants live in Africa and Asia. They eat grass, leaves, and fruits. An elephant can live up to 70 years. They are known as intelligent animals because they have good memory.
Teks report menggunakan simple present tense dan bersifat umum (general), bukan tentang individu tertentu.

flashcards.question: Apa fungsi sosial teks report?
flashcards.answer: Mendeskripsikan sesuatu secara umum dan memberikan informasi faktual.

flashcards.question: Tense yang digunakan dalam teks report?
Apa perbedaan report dan descriptive text?
flashcards.answer: Report bersifat umum (general), descriptive tentang sesuatu yang spesifik.

questions.question: What is the social function of a report text?
options: To tell how to make something
questions.explanation: Teks report mendeskripsikan sesuatu secara umum.

questions.question: Which tense is mostly used in report texts?
questions.explanation: Teks report umumnya menggunakan Simple Present Tense.

questions.question: The first paragraph of a report text is called:
questions.explanation: Paragraf pertama teks report adalah General Classification.

topics.title: Narrative Text
topics.description: Teks narrative: fungsi sosial, struktur, fitur kebahasaan, dan menemukan informasi rinci.

content.text: Narrative text adalah teks yang menceritakan sebuah kisah atau peristiwa, biasanya berbentuk cerita fiksi, legenda, atau dongeng. Tujuannya untuk menghibur pembaca.

items: Mengajarkan nilai moral (to teach a moral value)
Orientation: Pengenalan tokoh, latar, dan waktu
Complication: Masalah atau konflik yang terjadi
Menggunakan action verbs: went, ran, cried, shouted
Menggunakan conjunctions of time: once upon a time, one day, then, finally
Menggunakan adverbs of manner: slowly, happily, carefully

content.text:
The Lion and the Mouse

Once upon a time, a lion was sleeping in the forest. A little mouse ran over his face and woke him up. The lion caught the mouse and wanted to eat her.

The mouse begged, 'Please let me go. I will help you someday.' The lion laughed but let her go.

A few days later, the lion was caught in a hunter's net. He roared loudly. The little mouse heard him and came quickly. She bit the net and set the lion free.

Moral: Even small friends can be great help.
Perhatikan penggunaan simple past tense: was sleeping, ran, caught, woke, laughed, bit.

flashcards.question: Apa fungsi sosial teks narrative?
flashcards.answer: Untuk menghibur dan mengajarkan nilai moral.

flashcards.question: Contoh time conjunction dalam narrative?
flashcards.answer: Once upon a time, one day, then, finally.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a narrative text?
questions.explanation: Teks narrative bertujuan untuk menghibur pembaca.

questions.question: Which part tells the problem in a narrative?
questions.explanation: Complication adalah bagian yang menceritakan masalah/konflik.

questions.question: 'The wolf ran into the forest.' What tense is used?
questions.explanation: 'Ran' adalah bentuk simple past tense dari run.

topics.title: Advertisement (Teks Iklan)
topics.description: Teks iklan: fungsi sosial, struktur, fitur kebahasaan, dan menemukan informasi rinci.

content.text: Advertisement adalah teks yang dibuat untuk mempromosikan produk, jasa, atau acara. Tujuannya untuk membujuk pembaca agar membeli atau menggunakan sesuatu.

items: Call to Action: Ajakan untuk bertindak (Buy now! Call us!)
Menggunakan kata sifat positif: delicious, amazing, best, fantastic
Menggunakan kata kerja ajakan: buy, get, call, visit, order

content.text:
FRESH FRUIT JUICE - The Best Drink for Your Health!

Made from 100% real fruits. No sugar added!

Benefits:
- Rich in vitamins
- Boosts your energy
- Keeps you fresh all day

Special Price: Only Rp15,000

Visit our store or call 0812-3456-7890.
BUY NOW!
Perhatikan penggunaan kata sifat positif (best, rich, special) dan call to action (BUY NOW!).

flashcards.question: Sebutkan 3 bagian struktur iklan!
flashcards.answer: Headline, Product Description, Call to Action.

flashcards.question: Jenis kata yang sering digunakan dalam iklan?
flashcards.answer: Kata sifat positif: amazing, best, fantastic, delicious.

flashcards.question: Apa itu 'Call to Action'?
flashcards.answer: Ajakan untuk bertindak, seperti 'Buy now!' atau 'Call us!'

questions.question: What is the social function of an advertisement?
options: To persuade people to buy something
questions.explanation: Iklan bertujuan untuk membujuk orang agar membeli.

questions.question: Which of these is a 'call to action'?
questions.explanation: 'Buy now!' adalah ajakan untuk bertindak (call to action).

questions.question: Advertisements often use _______ words to attract buyers.
questions.explanation: Iklan menggunakan kata-kata positif untuk menarik pembeli.

topics.title: Present Continuous Tense
topics.description: Membaca dan merespon teks yang berkaitan dengan aktivitas yang sedang terjadi.

content.text: Present Continuous Tense digunakan untuk menyatakan aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung pada saat ini (now) atau di sekitar waktu sekarang.

items: She is reading a book now.
They are playing football in the yard.
I am not watching TV at the moment.
Is he studying English? Yes, he is.
Rencana di masa depan yang sudah pasti: I am meeting my friend tomorrow.
Perubahan atau perkembangan: The weather is getting colder.

content.text: Gunakan am untuk I, is untuk He/She/It, dan are untuk You/We/They.

flashcards.question: Time signal Present Continuous?
flashcards.answer: now, at the moment, right now, currently

flashcards.question: Apa penggunaan lain Present Continuous?
flashcards.answer: Rencana masa depan yang sudah pasti.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: Rumus yang benar: S + is + V-ing.

questions.question: Negative form: 'They are playing games.'
questions.explanation: Negatif: S + are + not + V-ing.

questions.question: Which sentence uses Present Continuous for future plan?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous dapat digunakan untuk rencana masa depan yang sudah pasti.

topics.title: Short Message
topics.description: Memahami dan menyimpulkan informasi teks pesan singkat.

content.text: Short message adalah pesan singkat yang ditulis untuk menyampaikan informasi penting secara cepat. Biasanya berbentuk SMS, chat, atau catatan singkat.

items: Menggunakan singkatan umum: ASAP (as soon as possible), FYI (for your information)
Tidak perlu kalimat yang terlalu panjang

content.text:
Hi Rina,

Don't forget we have English class at 2 PM today. Bring your dictionary and notebook. See you there!

- Aldo
Pesan singkat harus jelas, singkat, dan langsung menyampaikan maksud.

flashcards.question: Apa tujuan short message?
flashcards.answer: Menyampaikan informasi penting secara cepat dan singkat.

questions.question: What does 'ASAP' mean?
questions.explanation: ASAP = as soon as possible.

questions.question: A short message usually contains:
questions.explanation: Pesan singkat berisi informasi yang singkat dan jelas.

questions.question: 'BTW' stands for:
questions.explanation: BTW = by the way.

topics.title: Comparison Degree
topics.description: Menganalisis ide utama dan informasi khusus pada teks yang berkaitan dengan perbandingan.

content.text: Degrees of Comparison digunakan untuk membandingkan sifat atau kualitas antara dua atau lebih benda, orang, atau hewan.
Contoh Kata Sifat Pendek (1-2 suku kata)

items: Positive: tall → John is as tall as Mike.
Comparative: taller → John is taller than Mike.
Superlative: tallest → John is the tallest student in class.

content.text: Contoh Kata Sifat Panjang (2+ suku kata)

items: Positive: beautiful → She is as beautiful as her sister.
Comparative: more beautiful → She is more beautiful than her sister.
Superlative: most beautiful → She is the most beautiful girl in town.

content.text: Perhatikan: good → better → best; bad → worse → worst.

flashcards.question: Contoh kalimat positive degree?
flashcards.answer: She is as tall as her brother.

questions.question: The comparative form of 'expensive' is:
questions.explanation: Kata sifat panjang (2+ suku kata) menggunakan 'more' untuk comparative.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: She is more taller than me.
She is the taller than me.
questions.explanation: Comparative dari tall adalah taller (tidak perlu more).

questions.question: 'This is _______ book I have ever read.'
questions.explanation: Superlative dari good adalah the best.

topics.title: Recount Text
topics.description: Memahami teks recount yang menceritakan kembali peristiwa masa lalu.

content.text: Recount text adalah teks yang menceritakan kembali peristiwa atau pengalaman yang sudah terjadi di masa lalu. Tujuannya untuk menceritakan, menghibur, atau menginformasikan.

items: Menghibur pembaca dengan kisah masa lalu
Orientation: Pengenalan tokoh, waktu, dan tempat kejadian
Menggunakan conjunctions of time: first, then, after that, finally
Menggunakan adverbs of time: yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2020

content.text:
My Holiday in Bali

Last month, I went to Bali with my family. We stayed there for three days.

On the first day, we visited Kuta Beach. The sand was white and the water was clear. We played volleyball and swam in the sea.

On the second day, we went to Ubud. We saw beautiful rice terraces and visited a traditional market. I bought some souvenirs for my friends.

On the last day, we relaxed at the hotel pool. It was a wonderful holiday. I hope I can visit Bali again someday.
Perhatikan penggunaan simple past tense: went, stayed, visited, played, swam, bought.

flashcards.question: Contoh adverb of time dalam recount?
flashcards.answer: yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2020.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a recount text?
questions.explanation: Recount text menceritakan kembali peristiwa masa lalu.

questions.question: Which tense is used in recount texts?
questions.explanation: Teks recount menggunakan Simple Past Tense.

questions.question: 'Last year, I _______ to Yogyakarta.'
questions.explanation: 'Went' adalah bentuk past tense dari go.

topics.title: Family Tree & Public Places
topics.description: Memahami informasi keluarga dan menyebutkan nama serta letak bangunan publik.

content.text: Family tree adalah diagram yang menunjukkan hubungan antar anggota keluarga. Dalam bahasa Inggris, penting untuk mengetahui kosakata keluarga.
Menyebutkan nama dan letak bangunan publik menggunakan preposition of place.

rows: The bank is in the city center.
The book is on the table.
The school is next to the mosque.
The park is between the bank and the post office.
The kitchen is behind the dining room.
The bus stop is in front of the school.
The supermarket is near my house.

items: The hospital is next to the bank.
The post office is between the library and the police station.
My father works at the office in the city center.
There is a new supermarket near my neighborhood.

content.text: Gunakan 'at' untuk titik tertentu, 'in' untuk area/daerah, dan 'on' untuk permukaan.

questions.question: My mother's brother is my _______.
questions.explanation: Saudara laki-laki ibu adalah paman (uncle).

questions.question: The library is _______ the school and the bank.
questions.explanation: 'Between' digunakan untuk posisi di antara dua benda.

questions.question: She works _______ the hospital.
questions.explanation: 'At' digunakan untuk titik/lokasi tertentu seperti hospital.

topics.title: Descriptive Text
topics.description: Menemukan informasi eksplisit pada teks deskripsi tentang gambaran hewan.

content.text: Descriptive text adalah teks yang mendeskripsikan sesuatu secara spesifik dan detail. Tujuannya untuk menggambarkan objek, orang, hewan, atau tempat tertentu sehingga pembaca dapat membayangkannya.

items: Membuat pembaca merasakan atau membayangkan sesuatu
Description: Deskripsi bagian-bagian, kualitas, karakteristik, dan sifat objek
Menggunakan kata sifat (adjectives) yang detail: beautiful, fierce, fluffy, enormous
Menggunakan linking verbs: is, am, are, looks, seems
Menggunakan kata keterangan (adverbs): very, quite, extremely

content.text:
My Cat, Milo

I have a pet cat named Milo. He is a Persian cat with long, white fur. His eyes are round and blue, like two beautiful sapphires.

Milo has a small pink nose and soft paws. He is very playful but sometimes lazy. He loves to sleep on the sofa all day.

Every morning, Milo waits for me at the door. He is not just a pet; he is my best friend.
Teks deskripsi bersifat spesifik (tentang Milo), berbeda dengan teks report yang bersifat umum (tentang kucing secara umum).

flashcards.question: Contoh linking verb dalam descriptive text?

questions.question: What is the purpose of a descriptive text?
options: To describe a specific thing in detail
questions.explanation: Teks deskripsi mendeskripsikan sesuatu yang spesifik secara detail.

questions.question: Which text describes a specific cat named Milo?
questions.explanation: Teks yang mendeskripsikan Milo secara spesifik adalah descriptive text.

questions.question: 'His fur is very soft and white.' This sentence uses:
questions.explanation: Teks deskripsi menggunakan Simple Present Tense.

topics.title: Writing & Presenting
topics.description: Menyusun paragraf acak, menemukan informasi spesifik, dan membuat iklan produk.

content.text: Peserta didik mengomunikasikan ide dan pengalaman melalui paragraf sederhana dan terstruktur, menggunakan kosakata spesifik dan struktur kalimat sederhana.

items: Deskripsikan produk dengan kata sifat positif
Gunakan call to action yang kuat

content.text: Menemukan Informasi Spesifik dari Teks Report

items: Baca judul dan identifikasi topik utama
Perhatikan detail seperti angka, nama tempat, atau ciri khusus
Pastikan jawaban sesuai dengan yang ditanyakan

content.text: Saat menyusun paragraf acak, perhatikan kata sambung waktu dan urutan logis cerita.

flashcards.question: Langkah pertama menyusun paragraf acak narrative?
flashcards.answer: Cari paragraf orientation (pengenalan tokoh, waktu, tempat).

flashcards.question: Apa yang perlu ada dalam iklan produk?
flashcards.answer: Headline, deskripsi produk, manfaat, harga, kontak, call to action.

flashcards.question: Tips mencari informasi spesifik?
flashcards.answer: Baca judul, cari kata kunci, perhatikan detail angka/nama/tempat.

questions.question: When arranging jumbled paragraphs of a narrative, you should look for:
questions.explanation: Orientation adalah bagian pengenalan yang biasanya ada di awal.

questions.question: Which is important in an advertisement?
questions.explanation: Call to action penting dalam iklan untuk mengajak pembaca bertindak.

questions.question: To find specific information in a report text, you should:
options: Look for keywords related to the question
questions.explanation: Cari kata kunci yang berhubungan dengan pertanyaan untuk menemukan informasi spesifik.
